# Hard Rock (G4)

Hard Rock is a small peach-orange Earth-pony colt with a deep blue-teal mane and tail, muted blue-gray eyes, and a cutie mark showing a guitar with two musical notes. You may recognize him as one of the youngsters learning to lift weights from Bulk Biceps in *Friendship Is Magic*.

**Name and voice:** “Hard Rock” is an unofficial fandom/wiki placeholder, not a verified spoken or credited name. It plausibly refers to his guitar cutie mark, but the original naming decision is undocumented. No dialogue, voice actor, or alternate identity is verified. His body model is also used for “Barley Grind” and an unnamed Manehattan colt; these are not established as the same pony. [Foal catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Foals).

**Appearances:** *The Fault in Our Cutie Marks* (S6E19, 2016) and a background return in *Fame and Misfortune* (S7E14). The catalog also lists a *My Little Pony Established 1983* promotional short, “Let’s get PHABULOUS!”—a separate production, not evidence of another TV-story event. [Season 7 episode listing](https://iview.abc.net.au/show/my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic/series/7/video/ZW4155A014S00).

## Important moments

- **Bulk Biceps’s weight-lifting lesson — “The Fault in Our Cutie Marks” (S6E19):** Hard Rock appears among the foals Bulk is teaching, a small payoff to the Cutie Mark Crusaders’ earlier suggestion that Bulk become an instructor. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IecaL6I3pGA) (scene timestamp unavailable: the catalog gives an approximate first-appearance time, not one checked against this upload).
